verdict.rationale: OpenHands is an autonomous coding agent that accepts natural-language tasks and works toward set goals. It offers a web GUI and hosted cloud access, which a non-engineer could plausibly use to get working code without a handoff. Nothing in the evidence shows it can take a mockup or design file as input and turn it into an implementation, and the PM-oriented workflow is only implied. Missing for 10: mockup/design or image ingestion, documented design-to-code workflow, evidence non-engineers ship working implementations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
